title.raw: 卷四十六 志第二十二 地理七 Volume 46 Treatises 22: Geography 7

sentences.zh: 志第二十二 地理七

translations.literal: Treatise Twenty-Two, Geography Seven.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Twenty-Two: Geography, Part Seven.

sentences.zh: ○雲南 貴州

translations.literal: ○ Yunnan Guizhou
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Yunnan and Guizhou

sentences.zh: 雲南《禹貢》梁州徼外。

translations.literal: Yunnan, in the Tribute of Yu, was beyond the frontier of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan lay outside the Liang Province frontier as described in the Tribute of Yu.

sentences.zh: 元置雲南等處行中書省。

translations.literal: The Yuan established the Yunnan Branch Secretariat and other offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 治中慶路。

translations.literal: Its seat was at Zhongqing Route.
translations.idiomatic: Its administrative seat was at Zhongqing Route.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年二月癸丑平雲南，置雲南都指揮使司。

translations.literal: In the second month of Hongwu 15, on the day guichou, Yunnan was pacified and the Yunnan Regional Military Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the second month of Hongwu 15 (1382), Yunnan was pacified and the Yunnan Regional Military Commission was established.

sentences.zh: 乙卯置雲南等處承宣布政使司。

translations.literal: On the day yimao the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission and other offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission was established.

sentences.zh: 同治雲南府。

translations.literal: Together it governed Yunnan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It shared its seat with Yunnan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領府五十八，州七十五，縣五十五，蠻部六。

translations.literal: It governed fifty-eight prefectures, seventy-five subprefectures, fifty-five counties, and six barbarian districts.
translations.idiomatic: It governed fifty-eight prefectures, seventy-five subprefectures, fifty-five counties, and six barbarian districts.

sentences.zh: 後領府十九，御夷府二，州四十，御夷州三，縣三十，宣慰司八，宣撫司四，安撫司五，長官司三十三，御夷長官司二。

translations.literal: Later it governed nineteen prefectures, two frontier-administration prefectures, forty subprefectures, three frontier-administration subprefectures, thirty counties, eight pacification commissions, four pacification superintendencies, five consolation superintendencies, thirty-three native chieftaincies, and two frontier-administration native chieftaincies.
translations.idiomatic: Later it governed nineteen prefectures, two frontier-administration prefectures, forty subprefectures, three frontier-administration subprefectures, thirty counties, eight pacification commissions, four pacification superintendencies, five consolation superintendencies, thirty-three native chieftaincies, and two frontier-administration native chieftaincies.

sentences.zh: 北至永寧，與四川界。

translations.literal: North to Yongning, bordering Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: To the north it reached Yongning and bordered Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 東至福州，與廣西界。

translations.literal: East to Fuzhou, bordering Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: To the east it reached Fuzhou and bordered Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 西至幹崖，與西番界。

translations.literal: West to Ganya, bordering the Western Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: To the west it reached Ganya and bordered the Western Barbarians.

sentences.zh: 南至木邦，與交址界。

translations.literal: South to Mubang, bordering Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: To the south it reached Mubang and bordered Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 距南京七千二百里，京師一萬六百四十五里。

translations.literal: It was seven thousand two hundred li from Nanjing and ten thousand six hundred forty-five li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lay seven thousand two hundred li from Nanjing and ten thousand six hundred forty-five li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年編戶五萬九千五百七十六，口二十五萬九千二百七十。

translations.literal: In Hongwu 26 registered households numbered fifty-nine thousand five hundred seventy-six and population two hundred fifty-nine thousand two hundred seventy.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 26 it had fifty-nine thousand five hundred seventy-six registered households and a population of two hundred fifty-nine thousand two hundred seventy.

sentences.zh: 弘治四年，戶一萬五千九百五十，口一十二萬五千九百五十五。

translations.literal: In Hongzhi 4 households numbered fifteen thousand nine hundred fifty and population one hundred twenty-five thousand nine hundred fifty-five.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 4 it had fifteen thousand nine hundred fifty households and a population of one hundred twenty-five thousand nine hundred fifty-five.

sentences.zh: 萬曆六年，戶一十三萬五千五百六十，口一百四十七萬六千六百九十二。

translations.literal: In Wanli 6 households numbered one hundred thirty-five thousand five hundred sixty and population one million four hundred seventy-six thousand six hundred ninety-two.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 6 it had one hundred thirty-five thousand five hundred sixty households and a population of one million four hundred seventy-six thousand six hundred ninety-two.

sentences.zh: 雲南府元中慶路。

translations.literal: Yunnan Prefecture was Zhongqing Route under the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Prefecture had been Zhongqing Route under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年正月改爲雲南府。

translations.literal: In the first month of Hongwu 15 it was changed to Yunnan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Hongwu 15 it was redesignated Yunnan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領州四，縣九：

translations.literal: It governed four subprefectures and nine counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed four subprefectures and nine counties:

sentences.zh: 昆明倚。

translations.literal: Kunming, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Kunming (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年，岷王府自陝西岷州遷於此。

translations.literal: In Hongwu 26 the Princely Establishment of Min moved here from Minzhou in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 26 the Princely Establishment of Min was transferred here from Minzhou in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 永樂二十二年遷岷王府於湖廣武岡州，建滕王府於此，宣德元年除。

translations.literal: In Yongle 22 the Princely Establishment of Min was moved to Wugang Subprefecture in Huguang; the Princely Establishment of Teng was built here and abolished in Xuande 1.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 22 the Min princely mansion was moved to Wugang in Huguang, a Teng princely mansion was built here, and it was abolished in Xuande 1.

sentences.zh: 東有金馬山，與西南碧雞山相對，俱有關，山下即滇池。

translations.literal: To the east is Golden Horse Mountain, facing Green Chicken Mountain to the southwest; both have passes, and below them lies Dian Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the east stands Golden Horse Mountain, facing Green Chicken Mountain to the southwest; both have passes, and Dian Lake lies at their foot.

sentences.zh: 池在城南，週五百里，其西南爲海口，至武定府北，注於金沙江。

translations.literal: The lake is south of the city, five hundred li in circumference; its southwest outlet reaches north of Wuding Prefecture and flows into the Jinsha River.
translations.idiomatic: The lake lies south of the city and measures five hundred li around; its southwestern outlet reaches north of Wuding Prefecture and empties into the Jinsha River.

sentences.zh: 又東有盤龍江，西注滇池。

translations.literal: Farther east is the Panlong River, which flows west into Dian Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Panlong River, which flows west into Dian Lake.

sentences.zh: 東有赤水鵬、清水江二巡檢司。

translations.literal: To the east are the Chishui Peng and Qingshui River Pacification Offices.
translations.idiomatic: To the east are the Chishui Peng and Qingshui River pacification sub-offices.

sentences.zh: 富民府西北。

translations.literal: Fumin, northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Fumin (northwest of the prefectural seat).

sentences.zh: 東有螳良川，源自滇池，下流入金沙江。

translations.literal: To the east is the Tanglang River, which rises from Dian Lake and flows down into the Jinsha River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Tanglang River, which rises from Dian Lake and flows down into the Jinsha River.

sentences.zh: 東南有安寧河。

translations.literal: To the southeast is the Anning River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Anning River.

sentences.zh: 宜良府東少南。

translations.literal: Yiliang, east and slightly south of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Yiliang (east and slightly south of the prefectural seat).

sentences.zh: 東有大池江，一名大河，亦曰巴盤江。

translations.literal: To the east is the Dachi River, also called the Great River or the Bapan River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Dachi River, also known as the Great River or the Bapan River.

sentences.zh: 西有湯池巡檢司。

translations.literal: To the west is the Tangchi Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Tangchi pacification sub-office.

sentences.zh: 羅次府西北。

translations.literal: Luoci, northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Luoci (northwest of the prefectural seat).

sentences.zh: 舊屬安寧州，弘治十三年八月改屬府。

translations.literal: Formerly subordinate to Anning Subprefecture; in the eighth month of Hongzhi 13 it was transferred to the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly under Anning Subprefecture, it was transferred to the prefecture in the eighth month of Hongzhi 13.

sentences.zh: 西有星宿河，自武定府流入。

translations.literal: To the west is the Xingxiu River, which enters from Wuding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Xingxiu River, which enters from Wuding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又有沙摩溪，即安寧河。

translations.literal: There is also Shamoxi Stream, which is the Anning River.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Shamoxi Stream, which is the Anning River.

sentences.zh: 南有鍊象關巡檢司。

translations.literal: To the south is the Lianxiang Pass Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Lianxiang Pass pacification sub-office.

sentences.zh: 晉寧州西有大堡河，下流入滇池。

translations.literal: Jinning Subprefecture has the Dabao River to the west, which flows down into Dian Lake.
translations.idiomatic: West of Jinning Subprefecture is the Dabao River, which flows down into Dian Lake.

sentences.zh: 北距府百里。

translations.literal: One hundred li north of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It lies one hundred li north of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 領縣二：

translations.literal: It governed two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties:

sentences.zh: 歸化東北有交七浦，滇池下流。

translations.literal: Guihua has Jiaoqi Ford to the northeast, the lower reach of Dian Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Guihua has Jiaoqi Ford to the northeast, on the lower reach of Dian Lake.

sentences.zh: 呈貢州北。

translations.literal: Chenggong, north of the subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong (north of the subprefectural seat).

sentences.zh: 西有滇池，北有落龍河，南流入焉。

translations.literal: To the west is Dian Lake; to the north is the Luolong River, which flows in from the south.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Dian Lake; to the north is the Luolong River, which enters from the south.

sentences.zh: 安寧州西有呀嵕山，有煎鹽水，設鹽課提舉司，轄鹽井四。

translations.literal: Anning Subprefecture has Mount Yajiao to the west, with brine for salt-boiling; a Salt Tax Intendant Office was established governing four salt wells.
translations.idiomatic: West of Anning Subprefecture is Mount Yajiao, where brine is boiled for salt; a Salt Tax Intendant Office was set up there overseeing four salt wells.

sentences.zh: 天啓三年改設於琅井，此司遂廢。

translations.literal: In Tianqi 3 it was moved to Langjing and this office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianqi 3 the office was relocated to Langjing and this one was abolished.

sentences.zh: 又南有螳良川。

translations.literal: Farther south is the Tanglang River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the Tanglang River.

sentences.zh: 西有安寧河。

translations.literal: To the west is the Anning River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Anning River.

sentences.zh: 又有祿脿、貼琉二巡檢司。

translations.literal: There are also the Luoliao and Tieliu Pacification Offices.
translations.idiomatic: There are also the Luoliao and Tieliu pacification sub-offices.

sentences.zh: 東距府八十里。

translations.literal: Eighty li east of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It lies eighty li east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 領縣一：

translations.literal: It governed one county:
translations.idiomatic: It governed one county:

sentences.zh: 祿豐州西。

translations.literal: Lufeng, west of the subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lufeng (west of the subprefectural seat).

sentences.zh: 西有南平山，上有關。

translations.literal: To the west is Nanping Mountain, with a pass on it.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Nanping Mountain, which has a pass on its summit.

sentences.zh: 東有大溪，即安寧河。

translations.literal: To the east is a great stream, which is the Anning River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is a great stream, namely the Anning River.

sentences.zh: 西有星宿河，河東有老鴉關巡檢司。

translations.literal: To the west is the Xingxiu River; east of the river is the Laoya Pass Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Xingxiu River; east of the river is the Laoya Pass pacification sub-office.

sentences.zh: 又西有蘭谷關。

translations.literal: Farther west is Langu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is Langu Pass.

sentences.zh: 昆陽州東南有渠濫川，東北入於滇池。

translations.literal: Kunyang Subprefecture has the Qulan River to the southeast, which enters Dian Lake from the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast of Kunyang Subprefecture is the Qulan River, which flows northeast into Dian Lake.

sentences.zh: 北距府百五十里。

translations.literal: One hundred fifty li north of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It lies one hundred fifty li north of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 領縣二：

translations.literal: It governed two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties:

sentences.zh: 三泊州西北。

translations.literal: Sanbo, northwest of the subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sanbo (northwest of the subprefectural seat).

sentences.zh: 西有三泊溪，流入滇池。

translations.literal: To the west is Sanbo Stream, which flows into Dian Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Sanbo Stream, which flows into Dian Lake.

sentences.zh: 易門州西。

translations.literal: Yimen, west of the subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yimen (west of the subprefectural seat).

sentences.zh: 南有易門守禦千戶所，洪武二十四年置，舊縣治在焉。

translations.literal: To the south is the Yimen Garrison Battalion, established in Hongwu 24; the old county seat was there.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Yimen Garrison Battalion, established in Hongwu 24, where the old county seat had been.

sentences.zh: 萬曆三年復還縣治於此。

translations.literal: In Wanli 3 the county seat was restored here.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 3 the county seat was moved back here.

sentences.zh: 又南有黎崖山，產異馬，一名馬頭山。

translations.literal: Farther south is Liya Mountain, which produces unusual horses; it is also called Horse-Head Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is Liya Mountain, famed for unusual horses; it is also called Horse-Head Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西有九渡河，即祿豐縣大溪，下流入元江府界。

translations.literal: To the west is the Jiudu River, which is the great stream of Lufeng County; it flows down into the border of Yuanjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Jiudu River, namely the great stream of Lufeng County, which flows down into Yuanjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嵩明州洪武十五年三月改曰嵩盟。

translations.literal: In the third month of Hongwu 15 Songming Subprefecture was renamed Songmeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Hongwu 15 Songming Subprefecture was renamed Songmeng.

sentences.zh: 成化十八年復故。

translations.literal: In Chenghua 18 the former name was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 18 the former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 東北有羅錦山。

translations.literal: To the northeast is Luojin Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Luojin Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東有秀嵩山。

translations.literal: To the east is Xiushan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Xiushan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西北有東葛勒山。

translations.literal: To the northwest is Donggele Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Donggele Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東南有烏納山，牧漾水出焉，西南入滇池。

translations.literal: To the southeast is Wuna Mountain; the Muyang River rises there and enters Dian Lake from the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Wuna Mountain, where the Muyang River rises and flows southwest into Dian Lake.

sentences.zh: 又東南有嘉利澤，亦曰楊林澤。

translations.literal: Farther southeast is Jiali Marsh, also called Yanglin Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast is Jiali Marsh, also known as Yanglin Marsh.

sentences.zh: 又西有邵甸河，匯九十九泉，至昆明爲備龍江。

translations.literal: Farther west is the Shaodian River, which gathers ninety-nine springs and becomes the Beilong River at Kunming.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Shaodian River, which gathers ninety-nine springs and becomes the Panlong River at Kunming.

sentences.zh: 西有邵甸縣，洪武十五年三月屬州，尋廢。

translations.literal: To the west is Shaodian County, subordinate to the subprefecture in the third month of Hongwu 15 and soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was Shaodian County, placed under the subprefecture in the third month of Hongwu 15 and soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 東南有楊林縣，成化十七年十月廢。

translations.literal: To the southeast is Yanglin County, abolished in the tenth month of Chenghua 17.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast was Yanglin County, abolished in the tenth month of Chenghua 17.

sentences.zh: 又東有楊林守禦千戶所，洪武二十五年置。

translations.literal: Farther east is the Yanglin Garrison Battalion, established in Hongwu 25.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Yanglin Garrison Battalion, established in Hongwu 25.

sentences.zh: 又西有兔兒關巡檢司。

translations.literal: Farther west is the Tu'er Pass Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Tu'er Pass pacification sub-office.

sentences.zh: 西南距府百二十里。

translations.literal: One hundred twenty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It lies one hundred twenty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 曲靖府元曲靖路。

translations.literal: Qujing Prefecture was Qujing Route under the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Qujing Prefecture had been Qujing Route under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年三月爲府。

translations.literal: In the third month of Hongwu 15 it became a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Hongwu 15 it was made a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十七年四月升爲軍民府。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of year 27 it was promoted to a military-civilian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Hongwu 27 it was promoted to a military-civilian prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領州四，縣二。

translations.literal: It governed four subprefectures and two counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed four subprefectures and two counties.

sentences.zh: 西距布政司二百九十里。

translations.literal: Two hundred ninety li west of the provincial administration commission.
translations.idiomatic: It lies two hundred ninety li west of the provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 南寧倚。

translations.literal: Nanning, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Nanning (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 東南有石堡山，山西有元越州治，洪武二十八年正月廢。

translations.literal: To the southeast is Shibao Mountain; west of the mountain was the Yuan seat of Yue Subprefecture, abolished in the first month of Hongwu 28.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Shibao Mountain; west of the mountain stood the Yuan seat of Yue Subprefecture, abolished in the first month of Hongwu 28.

sentences.zh: 北有白石江，流合城南之瀟湘江，又東南合左小江，亦謂之南盤江，下流環雲南、澂江、廣西三府之境，至羅平州入貴州界。

translations.literal: To the north is the Baishi River, which joins the Xiaoxiang River south of the city, then southeast joins the Zuoxiao River, also called the Nanpan River; its lower course encircles the territories of Yunnan, Chengjiang, and Guangxi prefectures and enters Guizhou at Luoping Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Baishi River, which joins the Xiaoxiang River south of the city, then turns southeast to meet the Zuoxiao River—also called the Nanpan River—whose lower course skirts Yunnan, Chengjiang, and Guangxi prefectures before entering Guizhou at Luoping Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 東北有白水關巡檢司。

translations.literal: To the northeast is the Baishui Pass Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Baishui Pass pacification sub-office.

sentences.zh: 亦佐府東。

translations.literal: Yizuo, east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Yizuo (east of the prefectural seat).

sentences.zh: 元屬羅雄州。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan it belonged to Luoxiong Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Luoxiong Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，改屬府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongle it was transferred to the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongle reign it was transferred to the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西南有塊澤江。

translations.literal: To the southwest is the Kuaize River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Kuaize River.

sentences.zh: 陸涼州東有丘雄山，下有中涎澤，即南盤江所匯也。

translations.literal: Luliang Subprefecture has Qiuxiong Mountain to the east; below it is the Zhongyan Marsh, where the Nanpan River gathers.
translations.idiomatic: East of Luliang Subprefecture is Qiuxiong Mountain; below it lies Zhongyan Marsh, where the Nanpan River gathers.

sentences.zh: 西北有木容山，有關。

translations.literal: To the northwest is Murong Mountain, with a pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Murong Mountain, which has a pass.

sentences.zh: 又西有部封山。

translations.literal: Farther west is Bufeng Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is Bufeng Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又西有芳華縣，南有河納縣，元皆屬州，永樂初皆廢。

translations.literal: Farther west are Fanghua County and Henna County to the south; both belonged to the subprefecture under the Yuan and were all abolished at the beginning of Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west were Fanghua County and, to the south, Henna County; both had belonged to the subprefecture under the Yuan and were abolished early in the Yongle reign.

sentences.zh: 西南有陸涼衛，洪武二十三年三月以古魯昌地置，西南有喬甸，萬曆二年立營置戍於此。

translations.idiomatic: It lies one thousand twenty-five li south of the provincial administration commission.
